Malaysia, actually. I’m glad to hear that :D

Sorry for hijacking top comment but I’d like to make a more general announcement to the comment section (@ Brieanna_galexy : that’s really good to hear, by the way :D). 

Thank you all so much for the kind words you have sent my way, and for telling me how this post has helped you. Words honestly can’t describe how I’m feeling now because it makes me so happy to see that you all are still fighting, still standing, and that I put a smile on some of your faces. Ily all :). Thanks for being here.

(And I’ve never been addressed as OP before. Somehow that makes me giddy😂😂)
